notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1787). Words follow the Schirmer vocal score's spelling and punctuation: "Cosa è stato?" (libretto "Cos'è stato?"), "Quegli", "quell' indegno", "un' inganno", "coll' altra" and "dell' infame" with the apostrophe word on its own note, "alquanta" (libretto alquanto), "sacre manto" (libretto sacro), "s'appressa" and "v'accorre" without apostrophe, "mi vuole abbracciar", "non viene alcun", "un uom che al primo istante", "che un' inganno", "e l'indegno" (libretto l'iniquo), "compie il misfatto suo" sung twice without "orrendo", "fù", "chieggio", and in the aria "che fù il traditore" the first time and "chi fù" the second. IPA, word meanings and translations were drafted for this app (S20) and the IPA was checked against Castel. The recitative (bars 1-69) is Anna's and Ottavio's dialogue; in the aria (from bar 70) Anna sings her two quatrains, then the first again, with many repeats of "la chiede il tuo cor". IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.

phrases.translation: Don Ottavio! I am lost!
What is the matter?
Have pity, help me!
My dearest, be brave!
Gods above! Gods above!

phrases.original: Quegli è il carnefice del padre mio!
phrases.translation: That man is the one who murdered my father!
What do you mean?

phrases.original: Non dubitate più; gli ultimi accenti
phrases.translation: Have no more doubt: the last words

phrases.original: che l'empio proferì, tutta la voce,
phrases.translation: the godless man let fall brought back to me the whole voice
phrases.ipa: ke ˈlɛm.pjo pro.feˈri ˈtut.ta la ˈvo.tʃe

phrases.original: richiamar nel cor mio di quell' indegno,
phrases.translation: of that unworthy man into my heart,
phrases.ipa: ri.kjaˈmar nel ˈkɔr ˈmi.o di kwel inˈdeɲ.ɲo

phrases.translation: the one who, in my apartment…
Good heavens! Is it possible

phrases.original: che sotto il sacre manto d'amicizia
phrases.translation: that beneath the holy cloak of friendship
But how was it? Tell me about
this strange occurrence.

phrases.original: Era già alquanta avanzata la notte,
phrases.translation: The night was already well on,

phrases.original: quando nelle mie stanze, ove soletta
phrases.translation: when in my rooms, where, all by myself,
phrases.ipa: ˈkwan.do ˈnel.le ˈmi.e ˈstan.tse ˈo.ve soˈlet.ta

phrases.translation: I happened by ill luck to be,

phrases.original: entrar io vidi in un mantello avvolto,
phrases.translation: I saw come in, muffled in a cape,

phrases.original: un uom che al primo istante
phrases.translation: a man whom, at the very first,
I had mistaken for you;
but afterwards I knew

phrases.original: che un' inganno era il mio!
phrases.translation: that I was the one deceived!
Heavens! Go on!
Without a word he draws near me,

phrases.original: e mi vuole abbracciar; sciogliermi cerco;
phrases.translation: and tries to take me in his arms; I struggle to get free;

phrases.original: ei più mi stringe io grido!
phrases.translation: he only clutches me harder; I cry out!
phrases.ipa: ˈei ˈpju mi ˈstrin.dʒe jo ˈgri.do

phrases.original: non viene alcun; con una mano cerca
phrases.translation: nobody comes; with one hand he attempts
phrases.ipa: non ˈvjɛ.ne‿alˈkun kon ˈu.na ˈma.no ˈtʃer.ka

phrases.translation: to smother my cries,
and with the other he clasps me

phrases.original: stretta così, che già mi credo vinta.
phrases.translation: so hard that I believe I am already beaten.
phrases.ipa: ˈstret.ta koˈzi ke ˈdʒa mi ˈkre.do ˈvin.ta

phrases.translation: The villain! And then?
In the end the grief, the horror
of the vile assault

phrases.original: accrebbe sì la lena mia, che a forza
phrases.translation: so swelled my strength that by force
phrases.ipa: akˈkreb.be ˈsi la ˈle.na ˈmi.a ke‿a ˈfɔr.tsa

phrases.translation: of wrenching loose, writhing and doubling over,
I got free of him!
Thank heaven, I can breathe.
Then I scream all the louder,
I shout for help,

phrases.original: fugge il fellon, arditamente il seguo
phrases.translation: the scoundrel runs off; daringly I go after him
right out into the street, to hold him back,
and from the attacked I become the attacker;

glossGroups.gloss: I become the assailant of the assailed

phrases.translation: My father hurries to the spot,
insists on knowing who he is, and the wretch,

glossGroups.gloss: wants to know who he is

phrases.original: che del povero vecchio era più forte,
phrases.translation: who had more strength than the poor old man,
phrases.ipa: ke del ˈpɔ.ve.ro ˈvɛk.kjo ˈe.ra ˈpju ˈfɔr.te

phrases.translation: carries out his crime,
carries out his crime,
and strikes him dead.
You know now who it was that tried
to rob me of my honour,
who the betrayer was,

phrases.original: che il padre, che il padre mi tolse.
phrases.translation: who took my father, took my father from me.
phrases.ipa: ke‿il ˈpa.dre ke‿il ˈpa.dre mi ˈtɔl.se

phrases.original: Vendetta ti chieggio, la chiede il tuo cor,
phrases.translation: Avenge me, I beg you; your heart calls for it,
phrases.ipa: venˈdet.ta ti ˈkjɛd.dʒo la ˈkjɛ.de‿il ˈtu.o ˈkɔr

phrases.translation: your heart calls for it.

phrases.original: Rammenta la piaga del misero seno,
phrases.translation: Think of the wound in that wretched breast,
phrases.ipa: ramˈmen.ta la ˈpja.ga del ˈmi.ze.ro ˈse.no

phrases.original: rimira di sangue coperto, coperto il terreno,
phrases.translation: see once more the ground covered, covered with blood,
phrases.ipa: riˈmi.ra di ˈsaŋ.gwe koˈpɛr.to koˈpɛr.to‿il terˈre.no

phrases.original: se l'ira in te langue d'un giusto furor,
phrases.translation: if the wrath of a just rage grows faint in you,
phrases.ipa: se ˈli.ra‿in ˈte ˈlaŋ.gwe dun ˈdʒu.sto fuˈror

phrases.translation: of a just rage!
